observations.behavior: Adds a try/except block around the main workflow execution to catch exceptions before they propagate directly.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent an unhandled exception from leaving the workflow without recording terminal status, potentially avoiding orphaned rows in ClickHouse. P1.F4.H1 and P1.F5.H6 show this is used for failure recovery.

observations.behavior: Replaces hardcoded 30s timeout with RECALCULATION_PROGRESS_ACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (90s). P1.F1.H1 defines this constant.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes activity timeouts; while not changing core query correctness, it could affect how long progress updates are allowed to run before being cancelled or retried, relevant to warehouse ingestion reliability.

observations.behavior: Wraps final status update and adds _best_effort_mark_terminal backstop. Records real succeeded/failed counts even if the primary write fails, re-raising only if both writes fail.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides resilience against transient failures during recalculation completion, ensuring accurate status reporting rather than mislabeling a completed run as failed or leaving it non-terminal. P1.F4.H2 tests this behavior.

observations.limitations: The patch does not demonstrate actual runtime benefit, adoption, or incident avoidance. It relies on comments and test assertions without live metrics. No tier-3 systemic risk reduction is demonstrated across components; changes remain localized to experiment recalculation workflows.

No tier-3 systemic risk reduction is demonstrated across components; changes remain localized to experiment recalculation workflows.
review.reason: Substantive bounded improvement in workflow termination and failure recovery for experiment metric recalculation. The implementation includes explicit handling of edge cases and corresponding tests, but lacks broader systemic evidence or production impact proof.
review.posthog_relevance: Could help prevent orphaned ClickHouse rows from unhandled exceptions and improve accuracy of terminal state recording for experiment recalculations.
review.uncertainty: Assessment depends on whether these workflow improvements are adopted widely enough to materially reduce operational incidents; no such data exists here.
